files.headContent:
# ============================================================
#  Hilltop Village — 游戏参数配置文件
#  game-settings.yml
# ============================================================
#  此文件存储所有可通过 GUI 或命令修改的游戏参数。
#  使用 /hilltop config 在游戏内通过 GUI 界面编辑。
#  使用 /hilltop reloadconfig 重新加载此文件。
# ============================================================

# 游戏世界名称
world-name: world

# 村庄核心坐标
core:
  x: 0.0
  y: 100.0
  z: 0.0

# 最少/最多玩家数
min-players: 2
max-players: 6
# 胜利所需波次
victory-waves: 20
# 波次间隔（秒）
wave-interval-seconds: 30
# 波次超时保险（秒）：某波持续超过此时长仍未清波（例如残怪卡地形 / 木桩怪 / 节点不可达），
# 先把全部残存怪物传送到最近玩家身边并高亮，再宽限约 15 秒后强制清除，打破任何形态的卡死。
# 0 或负数 = 禁用该保险（fix4 起为默认值，追求纯净体验；卡住时可用
# /hilltop wave clear 手动强清清怪并推进波次）。改回正数（如 120）即可重新启用自动保险。
wave-timeout-seconds: 0

# 失败结算倒计时（秒）：显示本局战报后传送回大厅的等待时间
defeat-countdown-seconds: 20
# 待保护村民的最大生命值（村民全部阵亡 = 游戏失败）
villager-health: 20.0
# 掉线重连窗口（秒）：对局中掉线后保留位置的时长，0 = 关闭重连
rejoin-timeout-seconds: 60
# 空置自动结束（秒）：对局进行中在线成员为 0 持续此时长后自动结束本局（走正常结束路径），
# 0 或负数 = 禁用（不推荐）；建议大于 rejoin-timeout-seconds，先留足重连窗口再判空置
empty-arena-end-seconds: 120

# 地图恢复：对局结束时回滚本局被破坏/放置的方块
map-restore:
  enabled: true

# 侧边栏记分板
scoreboard:
  enabled: true

# ============================================================
#  重锤系统 (Hammer)
# ============================================================
hammer:
  # 重锤使用的物品材料（原版 Material 名称）
  material: IRON_AXE
  # ItemsAdder 物品命名空间ID（格式: namespace:id）
  # 仅当 use-itemsadder 为 true 时生效
  itemsadder-id: ""
  # 自定义模型数据值（配合资源包使用，0 表示不使用）
  custom-model-data: 0
  # 是否启用 ItemsAdder 模型（true/false）
  use-itemsadder: false
  # 基础伤害值（已废弃：v1.1+ 由 tier 三档直接定伤害，不再读取）
  base-damage: 20.0
  # AOE 效果半径（已废弃：v1.1+ 由 tier 三档直接定范围，不再读取）
  effect-radius: 5.0
  # 余震减速持续时长（tick，20 tick = 1 秒）
  aftershock-ticks: 60
  # 猛击激活超时时间（tick，超时未落地则取消）
  smash-timeout-ticks: 600
  # 铁砧特效显示时长（tick）
  visual-display-ticks: 20
  # 每次猛击后的冷却时长（秒，0 表示无冷却）
  cooldown-seconds: 8.0
  # 重锤总可用次数（耗尽碎裂需商店回购，0 表示无限）
  max-uses: 30
  # === 三档独立配置（每档设定自己的蓄力距离 / 伤害 / 范围） ===
  # 注意：低档无 charge 阈值 —— 下落距离 < medium.charge 即判低档
  tier:
    low:
      damage: 20.0    # 低档造成伤害（甲虫 40 血需两下低档，中心命中）
      radius: 4.0     # 低档AOE范围（格）
    medium:
      charge: 5.0     # 触发中档所需的下落距离（格）
      damage: 40.0    # 中档造成伤害
      radius: 5.0     # 中档AOE范围（格）
    high:
      charge: 10.0    # 触发高档所需的下落距离（格）
      damage: 60.0    # 高档造成伤害
      radius: 6.5     # 高档AOE范围（格）
  # 旧版倍率字段（向后兼容，已废弃：v1.1+ 由 tier 三档直接定伤害/范围，不再读取）
  damage-low-threshold: 5.0
  damage-medium-threshold: 10.0
  damage-low-multiplier: 1.5
  damage-medium-multiplier: 2.0
  damage-high-multiplier: 3.0

# ============================================================
#  烈焰蛋系统 (Fireball)
# ============================================================
fireball:
  # 烈焰蛋使用的物品材料
  material: FIRE_CHARGE
  # 投射物飞行速度
  speed: 1.5
  # 爆炸伤害值
  damage: 15.0
  # 爆炸半径（格）
  explosion-radius: 4.0
  # 冷却时间（tick，20 tick = 1 秒，0 = 无冷却）
  cooldown-ticks: 3
  # 最大飞行时长（tick，超时自动消失）
  max-travel-ticks: 100
  # 击退强度（对怪物和自身均生效）
  knockback: 5.0
  # 近炸检测半径（格，0=禁用，投射物附近进入此范围的实体会触发爆炸）
  proximity-fuse: 1.5

# ============================================================
#  能量节点系统 (Nodes)
# ============================================================
nodes:
  # 节点基础生命值
  base-health: 100.0
  # 修复节点消耗的物品（默认恶魂之泪，击杀下界恶魂获得，也可在商店购买）
  repair-cost-item: GHAST_TEAR
  # 每次修复消耗几个
  repair-cost-amount: 1
  # 每消耗一个恢复多少节点血量
  repair-amount-per-cost: 50.0
  # 修复物品显示名（留空则使用 messages.yml 的 item.repair-cost-name）
  repair-cost-name: ""
  # 节点增益效果作用半径（格）
  buff-radius: 20.0
  # 节点增益效果（格式 "效果名:等级"，0 = I 级，1 = II 级，以此类推）
  buff-effects:
    - "RESISTANCE:0"
    - "REGENERATION:0"
  # 增益刷新周期（tick）
  buff-refresh-ticks: 60
  # 多个节点叠加时的最大等级
  buff-stack-cap: 3
  # 单次增益持续时间（tick）
  buff-duration-ticks: 100
  # 自爆对节点伤害倍率
  self-destruct-multiplier: 3.0
  # 节点扫描搜索半径（距核心水平距离，格；垂直方向为全高度扫描）
  search-radius: 128

# ============================================================
#  村民商店货币掉落 (Shop)
#  货币物品（默认能量水晶 EMERALD）与商品价格见 shop.yml
#  fix4 起为「每杀必掉、数量浮动」：每次击杀掉落 [min, max] 区间内的随机数量。
#  掉落实体数 = 每只怪 1 堆（数量体现在单堆 amount 上），同位置相邻掉落物
#  原版会自动合并；竞技场重置时也会统一清理残留掉落物，量大不会堆积卡服。
# ============================================================
shop:
  # 掉落概率门（0~1）：默认 1.0 = 每杀必掉；改为 0.5 即恢复「50% 概率掉」
  currency-drop-chance: 1.0
  # 每次掉落数量区间（含两端，运行时在区间内随机；0/0 = 关闭掉落）
  currency-drop-min: 1
  currency-drop-max: 2

# ============================================================
#  开局初始套装 (starter-kit, STORY-1.2)
#  开局传送后向每名在场玩家发放（背包在 join 时已清空快照，不会污染玩家原有物品）。
#  背包放不下的部分掉在玩家脚下；离场时整包清空、快照归还，套装不会被带出竞技场。
# ============================================================
starter-kit:
  # 总开关：false = 开局不发放任何物品
  enabled: true
  # 物品列表：每项 material（原版 Material 名）+ amount（数量，超单叠上限自动拆叠）
  # 默认：石剑 + 皮革四件套 + 面包x16 + 火把x8（烈焰蛋/任务锤默认不给，需在商店购买）
  items:
    - material: STONE_SWORD
      amount: 1
    - material: LEATHER_HELMET
      amount: 1
    - material: LEATHER_CHESTPLATE
      amount: 1
    - material: LEATHER_LEGGINGS
      amount: 1
    - material: LEATHER_BOOTS
      amount: 1
    - material: BREAD
      amount: 16
    - material: TORCH
      amount: 8

# ============================================================
#  怪物生成设置 (Spawning)
# ============================================================
spawning:
  # 生成半径最小值（距核心，格）
  spawn-radius-min: 20
  # 生成半径最大值（距核心，格）
  spawn-radius-max: 40
  # 生成高度偏移（生成点 Y 坐标的偏移量，0 = 与生成点同高）
  spawn-y-offset: 0
  # 全局怪物数量上限
  global-mob-cap: 80
  # 每名玩家的怪物数量上限
  mob-cap-per-player: 15
  # 单个飞行抛投者整局最多执行多少轮空投（防止抛投者无限空投导致实体数指数膨胀卡服）
  # 每轮空投受 global-mob-cap 与 mob-cap-per-player 双重限制；0 或负数 = 禁用空投
  airdrop-max-per-dropper: 3

# ============================================================
#  特殊怪物属性 (Monsters)
#  每个怪物的独立属性配置
#  按怪种掉落（drop-min/drop-max，可选键）：该怪种击杀时掉落 [min,max] 区间内随机
#  数量（含两端）。三特殊怪出厂带各自数值（见下）；其它怪种不写该两键 = 回退全局
#  shop.currency-drop-min/max（默认 1~2）。任一端写 -1 = 该端回退全局值；写 0/0 =
#  该怪种不掉币。空投小怪（抛投者空投出的僵尸）恒为 0，不受此表影响。
# ============================================================
monsters:
  # 自爆甲虫：靠近能量节点后自爆
  explode-beetle:
    display-egg: CAVE_SPIDER_SPAWN_EGG
    health: 40.0
    speed: 0.3
    hook-velocity: 1.0
    # 显示名留空时使用 messages.yml 的 mob.explode-beetle（随玩家语言切换）
    display-name: ""
    explode-damage-multiplier: 3.0
    # 自爆是否附带原版实体爆炸（false 时只结算节点伤害 + 纯视觉效果，不炸伤村民/玩家）
    entity-explosion: true
    cooldown-ticks: 0
    stun-duration-ticks: 0
    airdrop-mob-count: 0
    # 掉落：1 个（量多好打，与抛投者拉开差距）
    drop-min: 1
    drop-max: 1
  # 钩爪猎手：远程射击将玩家拖拽到身边
  hook-claw-hunter:
    display-egg: SKELETON_SPAWN_EGG
    health: 60.0
    speed: 0.25
    hook-velocity: 1.8
    # 显示名留空时使用 messages.yml 的 mob.hook-claw-hunter（随玩家语言切换）
    display-name: ""
    explode-damage-multiplier: 0
    cooldown-ticks: 60
    stun-duration-ticks: 40
    airdrop-mob-count: 8
    # 掉落：1~2 个
    drop-min: 1
    drop-max: 2
  # 飞行抛投者：飞行中向地面空投小怪
  flying-dropper:
    display-egg: PHANTOM_SPAWN_EGG
    health: 80.0
    speed: 0.3
    hook-velocity: 0
    # 显示名留空时使用 messages.yml 的 mob.airdrop-dropper（随玩家语言切换）
    display-name: ""
    explode-damage-multiplier: 0
    cooldown-ticks: 160
    stun-duration-ticks: 3
    airdrop-mob-count: 10
    # 掉落：2~3 个（飞在 +8 高度最难打，打难打的怪更值钱）
    drop-min: 2
    drop-max: 3

# ============================================================
#  波次配置 (Waves)
#  数字键 = 波次编号
#  default = 未特别配置的波次使用此模板
#
#  刷怪语义（STORY-1.4 精确配比）：
#    - count = 每人只数：该类型实际刷出 count × 在场人数 只。
#      示例：第 1 波配 甲虫 6 / 猎手 2，2 人局实际刷出 12 只甲虫 + 4 只猎手。
#    - total-mobs = 每人精确总数上限：sum(count) × 人数 超过它时按比例裁剪，不足不补齐。
#    - weight = 兼容权重：仅当本波所有 count 全 0/缺失时回退旧权重随机路径；正常路径忽略。
#    - 另有两层全局裁剪：spawning.mob-cap-per-player（人均上限）与
#      spawning.global-mob-cap（全局上限，含上一波残留）；三层取最小。
# ============================================================
waves:
  default:
    total-mobs: 10
    compositions:
      explode-beetle:
        count: 4
        weight: 3
      hook-claw-hunter:
        count: 3
        weight: 2
      flying-dropper:
        count: 3
        weight: 1
  "1":
    total-mobs: 8
    compositions:
      explode-beetle:
        count: 6
        weight: 5
      hook-claw-hunter:
        count: 2
        weight: 1
  "5":
    total-mobs: 14
    compositions:
      explode-beetle:
        count: 5
        weight: 3
      hook-claw-hunter:
        count: 4
        weight: 4
      flying-dropper:
        count: 5
        weight: 2
  "10":
    total-mobs: 20
    compositions:
      explode-beetle:
        count: 8
        weight: 4
      hook-claw-hunter:
        count: 6
        weight: 5
      flying-dropper:
        count: 6
        weight: 3

  # 最大飞行时长（tick，超时自动消失）
  max-travel-ticks: 100
  # 击退强度（对怪物和自身均生效）
  knockback: 5.0
  # 近炸检测半径（格，0=禁用，投射物附近进入此范围的实体会触发爆炸）
  proximity-fuse: 1.5

# ============================================================
#  能量节点系统 (Nodes)
# ============================================================
nodes:
  # 节点基础生命值
  base-health: 100.0
  # 修复节点消耗的物品（默认恶魂之泪，击杀下界恶魂获得，也可在商店购买）
  repair-cost-item: GHAST_TEAR
  # 单次修复最多消耗几个（按实际缺口取最少，够修就不多扣）
  repair-cost-amount: 1
  # 每消耗一个恢复多少节点血量
  repair-amount-per-cost: 50.0
  # 修复物品显示名（留空则使用 messages.yml 的 item.repair-cost-name）
  repair-cost-name: ""
  # 节点增益效果作用半径（格）
  buff-radius: 20.0
  # 节点增益效果（格式 "效果名:等级"，0 = I 级，1 = II 级，以此类推）
  buff-effects:
    - "RESISTANCE:0"
    - "REGENERATION:0"
  # 增益刷新周期（tick）
  buff-refresh-ticks: 60
  # 多个节点叠加时的最大等级
  buff-stack-cap: 3
  # 单次增益持续时间（tick）
  buff-duration-ticks: 100
  # 自爆对节点伤害倍率
  self-destruct-multiplier: 3.0
  # 节点扫描搜索半径（距核心水平距离，格；垂直方向为全高度扫描）
  search-radius: 128

# ============================================================
#  村民商店货币掉落 (Shop)
#  货币物品（默认能量水晶 EMERALD）与商品价格见 shop.yml
#  fix4 起为「每杀必掉、数量浮动」：每次击杀掉落 [min, max] 区间内的随机数量。
#  掉落实体数 = 每只怪 1 堆（数量体现在单堆 amount 上），同位置相邻掉落物
#  原版会自动合并；竞技场重置时也会统一清理残留掉落物，量大不会堆积卡服。
# ============================================================
shop:
  # 掉落概率门（0~1）：默认 1.0 = 每杀必掉；改为 0.5 即恢复「50% 概率掉」
  currency-drop-chance: 1.0
  # 每次掉落数量区间（含两端，运行时在区间内随机；0/0 = 关闭掉落）
  currency-drop-min: 1
  currency-drop-max: 2

# ============================================================
#  开局初始套装 (starter-kit, STORY-1.2)
#  开局传送后向每名在场玩家发放（背包在 join 时已清空快照，不会污染玩家原有物品）。
#  背包放不下的部分掉在玩家脚下；离场时整包清空、快照归还，套装不会被带出竞技场。
# ============================================================
starter-kit:
  # 总开关：false = 开局不发放任何物品
  enabled: true
  # 物品列表：每项 material（原版 Material 名）+ amount（数量，超单叠上限自动拆叠）
  # 默认：石剑 + 皮革四件套 + 面包x16 + 火把x8（烈焰蛋/任务锤默认不给，需在商店购买）
  items:
    - material: STONE_SWORD
      amount: 1
    - material: LEATHER_HELMET
      amount: 1
    - material: LEATHER_CHESTPLATE
      amount: 1
    - material: LEATHER_LEGGINGS
      amount: 1
    - material: LEATHER_BOOTS
      amount: 1
    - material: BREAD
      amount: 16
    - material: TORCH
      amount: 8

# ============================================================
#  怪物生成设置 (Spawning)
# ============================================================
spawning:
  # 生成半径最小值（距核心，格）
  spawn-radius-min: 20
  # 生成半径最大值（距核心，格）
  spawn-radius-max: 40
  # 生成高度偏移（生成点 Y 坐标的偏移量，0 = 与生成点同高）
  spawn-y-offset: 0
  # 全局怪物数量上限
  global-mob-cap: 80
  # 每名玩家的怪物数量上限
  mob-cap-per-player: 15
  # 单个飞行抛投者整局最多执行多少轮空投（防止抛投者无限空投导致实体数指数膨胀卡服）
  # 每轮空投受 global-mob-cap 与 mob-cap-per-player 双重限制；0 或负数 = 禁用空投
  airdrop-max-per-dropper: 3

# ============================================================
#  特殊怪物属性 (Monsters)
#  每个怪物的独立属性配置
#  按怪种掉落（drop-min/drop-max，可选键）：该怪种击杀时掉落 [min,max] 区间内随机
#  数量（含两端）。三特殊怪出厂带各自数值（见下）；其它怪种不写该两键 = 回退全局
#  shop.currency-drop-min/max（默认 1~2）。任一端写 -1 = 该端回退全局值；写 0/0 =
#  该怪种不掉币。空投小怪（抛投者空投出的僵尸）恒为 0，不受此表影响。
# ============================================================
monsters:
  # 自爆甲虫：靠近能量节点后自爆
  explode-beetle:
    display-egg: CAVE_SPIDER_SPAWN_EGG
    health: 40.0
    speed: 0.3
    hook-velocity: 1.0
    # 显示名留空时使用 messages.yml 的 mob.explode-beetle（随玩家语言切换）
    display-name: ""
    explode-damage-multiplier: 3.0
    # 自爆是否附带原版实体爆炸（false 时只结算节点伤害 + 纯视觉效果，不炸伤村民/玩家）
    entity-explosion: true
    cooldown-ticks: 0
    stun-duration-ticks: 0
    airdrop-mob-count: 0
    # 掉落：1 个（量多好打，与抛投者拉开差距）
    drop-min: 1
    drop-max: 1
  # 钩爪猎手：远程射击将玩家拖拽到身边
  hook-claw-hunter:
    display-egg: SKELETON_SPAWN_EGG
    health: 60.0
    speed: 0.25
    hook-velocity: 1.8
    # 显示名留空时使用 messages.yml 的 mob.hook-claw-hunter（随玩家语言切换）
    display-name: ""
    explode-damage-multiplier: 0
    cooldown-ticks: 60
    stun-duration-ticks: 40
    airdrop-mob-count: 8
    # 掉落：1~2 个
    drop-min: 1
    drop-max: 2
  # 飞行抛投者：飞行中向地面空投小怪
  flying-dropper:
    display-egg: PHANTOM_SPAWN_EGG
    health: 80.0
    speed: 0.3
    hook-velocity: 0
    # 显示名留空时使用 messages.yml 的 mob.airdrop-dropper（随玩家语言切换）
    display-name: ""
    explode-damage-multiplier: 0
    cooldown-ticks: 160
    stun-duration-ticks: 3
    airdrop-mob-count: 10
    # 掉落：2~3 个（飞在 +8 高度最难打，打难打的怪更值钱）
    drop-min: 2
    drop-max: 3

# ============================================================
#  波次配置 (Waves)
#  数字键 = 波次编号
#  default = 未特别配置的波次使用此模板
#
#  刷怪语义（STORY-1.4 精确配比）：
#    - count = 每人只数：该类型实际刷出 count × 在场人数 只。
#      示例：第 1 波配 甲虫 6 / 猎手 2，2 人局实际刷出 12 只甲虫 + 4 只猎手。
#    - total-mobs = 每人精确总数上限：sum(count) × 人数 超过它时按比例裁剪，不足不补齐。
#    - weight = 兼容权重：仅当本波所有 count 全 0/缺失时回退旧权重随机路径；正常路径忽略。
#    - 另有两层全局裁剪：spawning.mob-cap-per-player（人均上限）与
#      spawning.global-mob-cap（全局上限，含上一波残留）；三层取最小。
# ============================================================
waves:
  default:
    total-mobs: 10
    compositions:
      explode-beetle:
        count: 4
        weight: 3
      hook-claw-hunter:
        count: 3
        weight: 2
      flying-dropper:
        count: 3
        weight: 1
  "1":
    total-mobs: 8
    compositions:
      explode-beetle:
        count: 6
        weight: 5
      hook-claw-hunter:
        count: 2
        weight: 1
  "5":
    total-mobs: 14
    compositions:
      explode-beetle:
        count: 5
        weight: 3
      hook-claw-hunter:
        count: 4
        weight: 4
      flying-dropper:
        count: 5
        weight: 2
  "10":
    total-mobs: 20
    compositions:
      explode-beetle:
        count: 8
        weight: 4
      hook-claw-hunter:
        count: 6
        weight: 5
      flying-dropper:
        count: 6
        weight: 3

# ============================================================
#  Hilltop Village — 语言文件 (messages.yml)
# ============================================================
#  支持语言: en (English), zh (中文)
#  颜色代码使用 & 符号: &a=绿 &c=红 &e=黄 &6=金 &7=灰 &b=青 &r=重置
#  占位符: {0}, {1}, {2} ...
#  修改后使用 /hilltop lang <en|zh> 或重启服务器即可生效。
#
#  === 消息结构说明 ===
#  每个语言区块 (en/zh) 下的消息键必须一一对应。
#  新增语言键时请在 en 和 zh 区块中同步添加。
# ============================================================

en:
  # === 通用提示 ===
  no-permission: "&cNo permission."
  players-only: "&cThis command can only be used by a player."
  game-starting: "&aGame starting..."
  game-stopped: "&cGame stopped."
  received-hammer: "&6You received the Sacred Hammer!"
  received-fireball: "&cYou received a Fireball! Right-click to throw, explodes on impact."
  config-reloaded: "&aGame settings reloaded from game-settings.yml."
  messages-reloaded: "&aMessages reloaded from messages.yml."
  shop-reloaded: "&aShop config reloaded ({0} items)."
  game-start: "&6The defense has begun! Protect the village!"
  wave-start: "&eWave &6{0} &eis incoming — prepare yourselves!"
  wave-complete: "&aWave &6{0} &acleared! Excellent work!"
  wave-stuck-relocate: "&eWave &6{0} &ehas stalled — &f{1} &elingering monster(s) have been pulled to you and highlighted. Finish them off!"
  wave-stuck-purge: "&cWave &6{0} &csafeguard triggered: &f{1} &cunreachable monster(s) were force-cleared to break the stall."
  wave-clear-broadcast: "&6An admin forcibly ended wave &6{0}&e — &f{1} &emonster(s) cleared. Next wave coming up!"
  wave-skip-broadcast: "&6An admin skipped the intermission — wave &6{0} &6is starting now!"
  game-victory: "&6All waves survived! &aVICTORY!"
  game-defeat: "&cAll players have fallen. &4DEFEAT!"
  game-start-need-players: "&cCannot start: &f{0}&c/&f{1}&c players in the arena. Players must &e/hilltop join&c first (players in the lobby are not counted); change the minimum via &earenas.yml&c game.min-players, or &e/hilltop config&c for arenas without an explicit value."
  game-start-already-running: "&cA game is already in progress. Use /hilltop stop first."
  game-start-restoring: "&cArena &f{0} &cis restoring its map right now (or the last restore failed and needs a check). Please wait a moment; if it persists, check the console log."

  # === 多竞技场系统 ===
  player-joined: "&a{0} &ejoined the arena! &7(&f{1}&7/&f{2}&7)"
  player-joined-need-more: "&7Waiting for &f{0} &7more player(s) to start (&f{1} &7min)."
  player-left: "&c{0} &eleft the arena! &7(&f{1}&7/&f{2}&7)"
  countdown-message: "&eThe match starts in &6{0} &eseconds..."
  countdown-cancelled: "&cNot enough players — the countdown has been cancelled."
  game-started: "&a&lThe match has begun!"
  game-in-progress: "&cThe match is already in progress!"
  arena-not-deployed: "&cArena &f{0} &cis not deployed or enabled yet!"
  arena-not-deployed-hint: "&7[Admin] Run /hilltop setup in this world to deploy it. If it is enabled: false in arenas.yml, set it to true and restart the server (it queues on startup); otherwise /hilltop enable {0} queues it."
  game-ended: "&6&lThe match has ended."
  game-ended-no-players: "&cAll players have left — the match is over."
  game-force-stopped: "&6&lThe match has been terminated by an admin."
  arena-full: "&cThis arena is full!"
  arena-disabled: "&cThis arena is disabled!"
  arena-started: "&cGame has already started!"
  arena-not-found: "&cArena &f{0} &cnot found!"
  already-in-arena: "&cYou are already in an arena! Use &e/hilltop leave &cfirst."
  not-in-arena: "&cYou are not in any arena!"
  no-arenas-available: "&cNo arenas available at the moment!"
  arena-list-header: "&6&l=== Arena List ==="
  arena-list-entry: "&7[{0}] &e{1} &7- {2} &7- &a{3} players"
  arena-list-footer: "&7Use &e/hilltop join <arena> &7to join an arena!"
  arena-status-waiting: "&aWaiting"
  arena-status-starting: "&6Starting"
  arena-status-running: "&cRunning"
  arena-status-ending: "&8Ending"
  arena-status-undeployed: "&7Not deployed"
  arena-status-map-missing: "&8Map missing"
  arena-map-missing: "&cMap save not found (world not loaded)"
  gui-arena-admin-hint: "&8[Admin] Run /hilltop setup inside this arena world"
  arena.access-denied: "&cYou have not joined this arena — you cannot enter its world. Use &e/hilltop join &cto join a match."

  # === 启用 / 禁用竞技场（维护通道） ===
  arena-status-disabled: "&8Disabled"
  arena-status-queued: "&eQueued for enabling"
  arena-status-loading: "&6Loading..."
  arena-enable-queued: "&aArena &f{0} &aadded to the enable queue — it will become available once loading finishes."
  arena-enable-already-ready: "&eArena &f{0} &eis already available."
  arena-enable-already-queued: "&eArena &f{0} &eis already in the enable queue."
  arena-enable-failed: "&cCould not enable arena &f{0}&c. If it is enabled: false in arenas.yml, set it to true and restart the server (it queues on startup); otherwise check arenas.yml and that its world folder exists."
  arena-disabled-ok: "&aArena &f{0} &adisabled — players can no longer join it."
  arena-already-disabled: "&eArena &f{0} &eis already disabled."
  arena-disable-in-progress: "&cA game is running on &f{0}&c — disable it after the match ends."
  arena-status-header: "&6&l=== Arena Status ==="
  arena-list-help-title: "&6&l=== Hilltop Village Commands ==="
  arena-list-help-admin: "&cAdmin commands:"
  arena-status-statistics: "&7Total: &e{0} &7| &aWaiting: {1} &7| &6Starting: {2} &7| &cRunning: {3} &7| &8Ending: {4}"
  arena-detail-title: "&e{0} &7({1})"
  arena-detail-status: "  &7Status: {0}{1}"
  arena-detail-status-unknown: "&7Unknown"
  arena-detail-players: "  &7Players: &a{0}&7/&e{1} &7(Min: &c{2}&7)"
  arena-detail-wave: "  &7Wave: &6{0}&7/&e{1}"
  arena-detail-world: "  &7World: &b{0}{1}"
  arena-detail-world-unloaded: " &c(Not loaded)"
  arena-issue-flag-disabled: " &7(enabled: false in arenas.yml → set it to true and restart the server to queue it)"
  arena-issue-disabled: " &7(closed by /hilltop disable → use /hilltop enable {0} to restore)"
  arena-issue-world: " &c(World not loaded → check that the world folder exists)"
  arena-issue-undeployed: " &7(Spawn points not configured yet → run /hilltop setup)"
  arena-left: "&aYou have left the arena!"
  arena-auto-left: "&7You were still listed in an arena — left it automatically to join the new one."
  player-only-command: "&cOnly players can use this command!"
  join-failed: "&cFailed to join arena &f{0}&c!"
  no-active-arenas: "&cNo active arenas at the moment!"
  arena-no-spawn-points: "&cThis arena has no spawn points configured!"
  arena-no-mob-spawns: "&cThis arena has no mob spawn points configured! Ask an admin to deploy them."
  goods-restored: "&aYour items have been restored!"

  # === 死亡与重生 ===
  player-died: "&c{0} &7has fallen in battle!"
  respawn-waiting: "&eYou have fallen! Your items are safe — they stay with you. You will respawn at the core when the next wave begins."
  respawn-blocked-no-node: "&cNo active energy nodes — you cannot respawn until a node is repaired!"
  respawned: "&aYou have respawned at the village core!"
  # G3c: return-to-lobby entry for mid-game players ({0} in hint.spectate-leave is the clickable button)
  hint.leave-command: "&7Want to leave the battle? &e/hilltop leave &7returns you to the lobby."
  hint.spectate-leave: "&7While waiting you can fly around freely to watch your teammates. Want to return to the lobby? Click &e[{0}] &7or type &e/hilltop leave"
  btn.return-lobby: "&cReturn to Lobby"

  # === 失败结算 ===
  defeat-all-down: "&4&lDEFEAT! &cAll players have fallen and no energy node remains."
  defeat-villagers-dead: "&4&lDEFEAT! &cAll villagers have been slain."
  defeat-not-enough-players: "&4&lDEFEAT! &cToo few players remain to continue."
  defeat-stats-header: "&6&l===== Battle Report ====="
  defeat-stats-line: "&e{0} &7- Kills: &f{1} &7| Deaths: &f{2} &7| Nodes repaired: &f{3} &7| Crystals: &f{4}"
  defeat-countdown: "&eReturning to lobby in &6{0} &eseconds..."

  # === 村民 ===
  villager.display-name: "&aVillager &7({0} HP)"
  villager-died: "&cA villager has been slain! &7Remaining: &f{0}"

  # === 掉线重连 ===
  player-reconnecting: "&e{0} &7disconnected — rejoin within &f{1}s&7 to keep their place."
  player-rejoined: "&a{0} &7is back in the fight!"
  rejoin-welcome: "&aWelcome back! You have rejoined the battle."

  # === 大厅保护 ===
  lobby-protected: "&cThe lobby is protected — you cannot do that here."
  build-mode-on: "&aBuild mode &lON &7— you can now build in the lobby."
  build-mode-off: "&7Build mode &lOFF &7— lobby protection restored."
  build.not-in-lobby: "&cBuild mode only applies to the lobby world (&f{0}&c). You are not in it."

  # === 记分板侧边栏 ===
  scoreboard.title: "&6&lHilltop Village"
  scoreboard.wave: "&eWave: &f{0}&7/&f{1}"
  scoreboard.alive: "&aAlive: &f{0}"
  scoreboard.spectators: "&7Awaiting respawn: &f{0}"
  scoreboard.starting: "&eStarting in &6{0}s"
  scoreboard.nodes: "&bNodes: &f{0}&7/&f{1}"
  scoreboard.villagers: "&dVillagers: &f{0}&7/&f{1}"
  scoreboard.waiting: "&7Waiting for players: &f{0}&7/&f{1}"
  scoreboard.kills: "&cYour kills: &f{0}"
  scoreboard.deaths: "&8Your deaths: &f{0}"
  scoreboard.crystals: "&aCrystals gained: &f{0}"
  scoreboard.separator: "&7&m---------------"
  scoreboard.next-wave: "&eNext wave: &f{0}s"
  scoreboard.mobs: "&cMobs left: &f{0}"
  scoreboard.arena: "&7Arena: &f{0}"
  scoreboard.state: "&7State: &f{0}"
  scoreboard.tip.loading: "&7Tip: &fRight-click the shop NPC to buy gear"
  scoreboard.tip.fallback: "&7Tip: &fRepair a node to keep it burning"
  tab.header.title: "&6&lHilltop Village"
  tab.header.arena: "&e{0} &7- &f{1}"
  tab.header.wave: "&eWave &f{0}&7/&f{1}"
  tab.header.hint: "&7Use &f/hilltop join &7to enter an arena"
  tab.footer.hint: "&7Use &f/hub &7to return to the lobby"
  tab.name.alive: "&a{0}"
  tab.name.dead: "&8[&7dead&8] &7{0}"
  tab.name.spectator: "&7[spec] {0}"
  tab.name.admin: "&c[admin] &f{0}"

  # === 玩家统计 ===
  stats.header: "&6&l===== Stats: {0} ====="
  stats.games: "&7Games played: &f{0}"
  stats.win-loss: "&7Wins: &a{0} &7| Losses: &c{1} &7| Win rate: &f{2}%"
  stats.kills-deaths: "&7Kills: &f{0} &7| Deaths: &f{1} &7| K/D: &f{2}"
  stats.nodes: "&7Nodes repaired: &f{0}"
  stats.crystals: "&7Energy Crystals collected: &f{0}"
  stats.waves: "&7Waves survived: &f{0} &7| Best wave: &f{1}"
  stats.self-hint: "&7Use &e/hilltop stats <player> &7to view someone else."
  stats.player-not-found: "&cNo stats found for player: &f{0}"
  stats.usage: "&cUsage: /hilltop stats [player]"
  stats.disabled: "&cStats are unavailable right now."

  # === 排行榜 ===
  top.header: "&6&l===== Top {0} ({1}) ====="
  top.entry: "&e{0}. &f{1} &7- &b{2}"
  top.empty: "&7No records yet."
  top.usage: "&cUsage: /hilltop top <{0}>"
  top.types: "&7Available: &f{0}"
  deploy.addvillager-added: "&aVillager registered at your current position."
  deploy.addvillager-coords: "&7  ID #{0}  X: {1}  Y: {2}  Z: {3}"
  deploy.listvillagers-header: "&6=== Villagers ({0} total) ==="
  deploy.listvillagers-empty: "&eNo villagers registered. Monsters will have nothing to raid."

  setup.step1: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &fConfirm game world: &b{world} &f— Is this correct? &7(Continuing will re-set the core location; the current value is kept until you confirm it in Step 2.)"

  setup.step3: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &fThis step deploys two independent sets of coordinates: &a① player spawns&f — where players are teleported when a game starts (respawns use the core from Step 2); &c② mob spawn points&f — where monsters spawn. At least &e1 of each&f is required."

  setup.step1: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &f确认游戏世界: &b{world} &f— 是否正确？&7（继续将重新设置核心坐标；原值在第 2 步确认前保留。）"

# ============================================================
#  _meta —— 插件自动维护，请勿手工编辑
#  记录「上次与出厂文案一致」的键，用于升级时自动更新未被自定义的文案。
#  只有当某个键的值仍等于插件发过的某个出厂值时才会被更新；
#  任何被改过的键都会进入 custom 列表并永久保留原样。
#  若想让某个键恢复出厂文案：把它改回出厂文案后重启（插件会自动移出 custom），
#  或者删掉该键后重启（插件会重新补入）。
# ============================================================
_meta:
  # 上次同步时的插件版本（plugin.yml 的 version）
  factory-version: "1.1.0-SNAPSHOT-fix2"
  # 上次同步的时间戳（毫秒）；没有实际变更时不刷新，避免每次启动都改动文件
  synced-at: 0
  # 每个键最后一次确认「与出厂值一致」时的出厂值哈希（SHA-256 前 16 位）
  keys: {}
  # 服主自定义过、永不被覆盖的键（绝对路径 locale.key）
  custom: []

  # === 部署向导 ===
  setup.step1: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &fConfirm game world: &b{world} &f— Is this correct? &7(Continuing will re-set the core location; the current value is kept until you confirm it in Step 2.)"
  setup.step2: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &fStand on the village core and click &a[Set as Core]&f. Optional: stand where players should gather before a match and click &b[Set as Waiting Area]&f — without it players wait on the core (the order does not matter; only [Set as Core] advances to the next step)."
  setup.step3: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &fThis step deploys two independent sets of coordinates: &a① player spawns&f — where players are teleported when a game starts (respawns use the core from Step 2); &c② mob spawn points&f — where monsters spawn. At least &e1 of each&f is required."
  setup.step3-mobspawns: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &fHow: stand at a spawn spot and click &e[Add Current Location]&f; stand at a mob spot and click &e[Add Mob Spawn]&f. With both sets ready, click &b[Open Spawn Points Overview]&f — the hub shows the count/status of both sets, lets you open the two sub-manager GUIs to review/delete, and carries the single &a[Done]&f button that advances to the next step; to leave early click &7[Save & Back to Lobby]&f — progress is kept."
  setup.step4-nodes: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &fEnergy nodes = respawn anchor blocks. Place respawn anchors in the map first, then stand next to a node block and click &a[Add Node]&f (or use the manager GUI) — nodes are registered &emanually&f, there is no auto-detect. &eAt least 1 node is required:&f with 0 nodes nobody can be revived (revival needs an active node to repair), and the match is lost the moment the last living player dies."
  setup.nodes-required: "&cYou need at least 1 registered energy node before continuing — with 0 nodes nobody can be revived, and the team loses as soon as the last living player dies (there is nothing to repair). Stand next to a respawn anchor and click &e[Add Node]&c."

  # === 部署向导 ===
  setup.step1: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &f确认游戏世界: &b{world} &f— 是否正确？&7（继续将重新设置核心坐标；原值在第 2 步确认前保留。）"
  setup.step2: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &f站在村庄核心位置，点击 &a[设为核心]&f。可选：站到玩家开局前的集合点点击 &b[设为等待区]&f —— 不设则玩家在核心上等开局（两个按钮顺序任意；只有 [设为核心] 会进入下一步）。"
  setup.step3: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &f本步要部署两套独立坐标：&a① 玩家出生点&f —— 开局时玩家被传送到的位置（阵亡复活用第 2 步的核心，不是这里）；&c② 怪物刷怪点&f —— 怪物出生的位置。两套各需 &e≥1 个&f。"
  setup.step3-mobspawns: "&6[&e{0}/{1}&6] &f做法：走到出生点位置点击 &e[添加当前位置]&f；走到刷怪点位置点击 &e[添加刷怪点]&f。两套点都配好后点 &b[打开生成点总览]&f —— 总览里显示两套点的计数与状态、可进入两个子管理界面查看/删除，并在此点击唯一的 &a[完成]&f 进入下一步；想中途退出点击 &7[保存并返回大厅]&f，进度不会丢。"

# ============================================================
#  _meta —— 插件自动维护，请勿手工编辑
#  记录「上次与出厂文案一致」的键，用于升级时自动更新未被自定义的文案。
#  只有当某个键的值仍等于插件发过的某个出厂值时才会被更新；
#  任何被改过的键都会进入 custom 列表并永久保留原样。
#  若想让某个键恢复出厂文案：把它改回出厂文案后重启（插件会自动移出 custom），
#  或者删掉该键后重启（插件会重新补入）。
# ============================================================
_meta:
  # 上次同步时的插件版本（plugin.yml 的 version）
  factory-version: "1.1.0-SNAPSHOT-fix2"
  # 上次同步的时间戳（毫秒）；没有实际变更时不刷新，避免每次启动都改动文件
  synced-at: 0
  # 每个键最后一次确认「与出厂值一致」时的出厂值哈希（SHA-256 前 16 位）
  keys: {}
  # 服主自定义过、永不被覆盖的键（绝对路径 locale.key）
  custom: []
